purpose: Reference contract for reviewing type, balloon geometry, spacing, and mobile readability before changing the renderer.

implementation_boundary.license_note: Use the upstream MIT license and attribution requirements if source code, rather than ideas, is copied.

type_selection.selection_rule: NanumGothic Regular is the house dialogue face. Confirm it remains comfortable with the same Korean dialogue at the mobile review width; nominal point size alone is not a decision criterion.

normal_dialogue.line_height: set so a bold word cannot touch the lines above or below at mobile width

dialogue.contour: one seamless clean outer path; the tail and balloon may not retain an internal junction line
dialogue.tail_shape: short, broad, gently tapered; join it into the balloon silhouette rather than outlining a separate triangle

approved_svg_balloon_assets.selection_rule: Select only an asset that passes vectorization-report.json and whose catalog group permits the text kind.
approved_svg_balloon_assets.default: Use the deterministic vector renderer for ordinary dialogue and any tail that must point at a speaker.
approved_svg_balloon_assets.fixed_tail: A selected asset with tail_behavior=baked keeps its original tail direction. Use it only for a deliberate tail-free special effect; ordinary dialogue and thought always use the dynamic renderer.
